directive.thread_id: cloud port lane writing-gate 2026-11-05: one generic list:settings and one shared Workshop reader
directive.quote: Settings home, decided: one generic list in the account, list:settings, with row type record:setting. A tool takes settings_record in its input and reads it at run time through one shared Workshop reader: a library folder with part.json.

job: read one of a person's tool settings, a row of their settings list, by its id at run time

distinct_from.why: Old trillion src/decision-store.mjs (before commit 4ffa1dc4a2, which deleted it with the Worker) kept a setting as one record of type setting (line 8) read by name (lines 751-753 setting(name), 758-762 settings(prefix)) inside the hosted record store. That store and file are gone from old trillion; the setting is now a row of the person's list read through the records door, so there is no live owner to copy. The read (id to value) is kept; a missing setting is refused instead of null.
Reads and parks writes of the computer app's own settings file on disk, not a person's tool settings in their account.

phrasings: read one of a person's tool settings, a row of their settings list, by its id at run time
